import type { IIdGenerator } from '#shared/ports/id-generator'

/**
 * The clean counter-example: a domain service that needs collaborators, does
 * not belong to a single entity, and touches nothing outside the pure layer.
 * A single finding here is a false positive.
 */
export class OrderPricer {
  constructor(private readonly idGenerator: IIdGenerator) {}

  price(cents: number): { id: string; cents: number } {
    return { id: this.idGenerator.generate(), cents }
  }
}
